instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Fashion and apparel retail chain with 45 stores across shopping malls in 3 countries. Fast-fashion model with 6-week design-to-shelf cycle. Facing margin pressure from ultra-fast-fashion online competitors. Exploring near-shoring production and RFID-based inventory visibility to improve replenishment speed. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale. We have some digital tools in place but integration between systems is ad-hoc. Innovation is championed by 1-2 internal advocates.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

input.changes_since_last: Hired 3 new team members. Launched customer feedback pilot. Budget for innovation increased 10%.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven New Value Proposition Discovery & Validation Engine
opportunities.rationale: To meet the strategic goal of identifying entirely new value propositions outside the fast-fashion cycle, this radical initiative will utilize AI lead scoring and customer feedback data to rapidly prototype and validate adjacent market opportunities (e.g., near-shoring model diversification). This directly addresses the need for non-incremental growth.

first_actions: Establish a cross-functional 'Adjacent Markets' task force including CTO, Head of Sales, and Lead Dev.
Define data requirements (CRM + Pilot Feedback) necessary to train lead scoring models on adjacent customer segments.
Allocate 20% of the increased budget for initial AI/ML tool subscription or custom model development scoping.
execution_plan.success_metric: Number of validated adjacent market opportunities with draft business cases approved.
milestones: Q3: MVP Lead Scoring Model deployed in pilot environment.
Q4: Three distinct, fully costed diversification proposals presented to leadership.

next_steps.action: Formalize and document the new innovation process workflow (Idea Intake -> Validation -> Budgeting) to address main barrier 'process'.
Implement targeted training for existing team members on emerging tech (AI integration, advanced data analysis) to mitigate 'talent' barriers.
Convert the successful customer feedback pilot into a scalable, automated data collection pipeline integrated with the CRM.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation process (currently partial maturity).
High dependence on CTO for both technical leadership and product ownership, creating a scaling bottleneck.
Inconsistent application of new digital tools due to ad-hoc system integrations.

improvements: Successful completion of the initial recommendation (Opp_1).
Increased innovation budget by 10% and hiring key talent to expand capacity.
Initiated customer feedback pilot, providing early informal insights into operational needs.
persistent_gaps: Gap between current execution capacity and the need for focused time on 'radical' diversification bets.
Formalizing governance structures needed to manage scaling across a growing organization.
Translating digital tool deployment (CRM) into strategic, integrated business value.
achieved_milestones: Completed Step 1 of the recommendation plan.
Successfully deployed and stabilized the new CRM system.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Maturity increased from partial (4.0) to improved execution level (6.2). Strategic focus has shifted from incremental improvement to radical diversification, requiring a higher maturity score to reflect the ambition and complexity of new initiatives.
